datasets.name: Open-Landslide Project (OLP) dataset
datasets.verbatim: In this study, we used the Open Landslide Project (OLP) dataset available at the link https://github.com/MicheleLicata/open_landslide_project.

datasets.name: Sentinel-2 L2A products
datasets.verbatim: In this research, satellite images of Sentinel-2 L2A products were utilized (https://sentinels.copernicus.eu/web/sentinel/missions/sentinel-2/data-products) due to their global availability and temporal resolution of 5 days, which are freely accessible for download since 2016 to the present.

methods.name: ExMAD (Expert-based Multi-temporal AI Detector)
methods.summary: ExMAD is an open-source methodological framework that integrates human expertise with a U-Net neural network to detect the occurrence timing and map shallow landslides using multitemporal Sentinel-2 imagery. The framework uses a modular structure where human experts validate landslide presence/absence, while the AI model processes raster data to identify landslide patterns.
methods.source: Michele Licata, Stefano Faga, Giandomenico Fubelli
methods.verbatim: We developed ExMAD (Expert-based Multi-temporal AI Detector), an open-source methodological framework (https://github.com/NewGeoProjects/ExMAD) to integrate artificial intelligence with human expertise to detect occurrence timing of a targeted landslide.
